exposure: recommendations from friends/family to use BMS
health professional's recommendation to use breast milk substitutes (BMS)
exposure to BMS promotions outside the health system
breastfeeding support from a health professional
outcome: breast milk substitutes (BMS) feeding prior to facility discharge
cohort: 610 mothers discharged from delivery facilities in Phnom Penh, Cambodia and Kathmandu Valley, Nepal
finding: Receiving a health professional's recommendation to use BMS was strongly associated with increased odds of BMS feeding before discharge in both Phnom Penh and Kathmandu Valley.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with BMS use among mothers in Kathmandu Valley.
